purpose: Additional user-requested original TLC Guild reference photos; pixel audit for GP12 Library and GP8 Chamber, 2026-09-12.
download_scope: All external image bytes and retrieved HTML kept only in ignored tmp/conformance/reference-guild-additional. No game assets extracted or imported.
method: Search web and Steam original-TLC app204030 image listings; download direct Steam image URLs without resize suffix; view each cited image at stored resolution.
page_verification_note: Stored original app204030 listing HTML contains matching data-appid, screenshot IDs, titles and direct image URLs. Individual detail URL fetches currently return a generic Steam Workshop JS shell, so version attribution relies on the accessible app listing plus the actual classic pixels.
gp12_result: No contradiction found. Two additional classic Library views independently support continuous floor-supported wooden cases with full-height posts and dense shelf rows. Both show burning late-story state; desk location/size and four normal warm lamps remain explicit route-safe adaptations, not screenshot claims.
gp8_result: New neutral wide and close wall views support cool masonry, attached pointed framing, quiet framed relief bays and broad shallow steps. They provide stronger future targets for nested medallion panels, exact colored window strips and story frescoes; no full-scale accuracy claim.

references.name: library-steam-02.jpg
references.version_confidence: High: image card belongs to Steam app 204030 and inspected classic models, HUD and textures; exact patch/mod status unknown.
visible_findings: Several continuous tall wooden bookcases around the corner behind the Guildmaster.
Dense rows of assorted books interrupted by narrow shelves, vertical posts and a carved bottom panel.
limits: Hero and Guildmaster occlude most room.
Fire and cutscene light are exceptional; do not infer neutral lighting.
No reading-table dimensions or normal wall-lamp arrangement established.

references.name: chamber-steam-07.jpg

User-uploaded screenshot; no mod declaration available.
